name: European walking route E9, Queen Elizabeth Country Park to Jevington
description_md:
The European walking route E9 extends from Queen Elizabeth Country Park to Jevington. This waymarked hiking route covers 114.5 km within the international waymarked hiking network.

The route is signposted as E9 and involves 2636 m of ascent and 2693 m of descent. It is classified as hard due to the distance and ascent. The walking time is about 36 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule. The path passes the Long Man of Wilmington within 100 m.
